Median visit length 04

Explain this

For each case, subtracts its first event timestamp from its last; reports the median across cases.

X-Ray → Triage loopbacks 05
—
—
Explain this

Counts adjacent X-Ray then Triage events. Rate is loopback cases / all cases; the sublabel also shows loopbacks among cases with X-Ray.

Simplified conformance 06
—
—
Explain this

A case conforms when it includes Registration → Triage → Doctor Consultation → Treatment → Discharge in order and has no adjacent X-Ray → Triage return. Other activities may occur between required steps.

Median transition wait 07
—
Across adjacent event transitions
Explain this

Median of elapsed minutes between each pair of consecutive events in each case.

90th percentile wait 08
—
Across adjacent event transitions
Explain this

90th percentile of all adjacent-event waits, using linear interpolation between sorted observations.

How to read this check

Targets: 1,217 loopbacks and 75.66% compliance for the embedded simulated log. A different uploaded CSV may not match these targets.

Loopbacks compare to 1,217 events; compliance compares to 75.66% (±0.01 percentage points). These are verification targets, not real-world findings.

Limitations

Keep these caveats with any screenshot, export, or presentation of this studio.

SIMULATED DATA
  • Simulated data: this event log is synthetic and does not describe real patients or hospital operations.
  • Injected loopbacks by design: the X-Ray → Triage returns are part of the illustrative simulation.
  • Simplified conformance: checks an ordered required-path spine and excludes cases with the specified loopback; it is not clinical protocol validation.
  • Illustrative scenarios: what-if results model reductions in observed wait only and do not predict operational or clinical outcomes.
